apptoken.label: API token
apptoken.description: Cider → Settings → Connectivity → External Application Access. Leave empty to reuse ~/.config/cider-kde-notifier/config.json.

base_url.label: API URL
base_url.description: Cider Connectivity base URL. Default http://127.0.0.1:10767 works for local installs.

display_mode.label: Track alert
display_mode.description: What to show when the track changes: a notification, the rich OSD card, or nothing.

save_to_history.label: Keep in notification history
save_to_history.description: Also save track-change notifications to history. Off by default.

osd_duration_ms.label: Alert duration
osd_duration_ms.description: How long the notification or OSD card stays visible (milliseconds).

lyrics_osd_enabled.label: Lyrics HUD
lyrics_osd_enabled.description: Sticky karaoke overlay. Left-click the bar chip toggles it (remappable in the widget editor).

lyrics_osd_position.label: HUD position
lyrics_osd_position.description: Where the overlay sits on screen.

lyrics_osd_show_next.label: Show next line
lyrics_osd_show_next.description: Dim preview of the upcoming lyric under the current line.

lyrics_osd_animate_cues.label: Animate cue dots
lyrics_osd_animate_cues.description: Pulse the three cue dots through intros and interludes. Off = static dots.

lyrics_osd_karaoke.label: Word highlight
lyrics_osd_karaoke.description: Highlight the sung word when Apple syllable timings exist. Line-timed lyrics light the whole line.

lyrics_osd_glow.label: Drop shadow
lyrics_osd_glow.description: Offset shadow under lyrics so they stay readable on busy wallpapers.

lyrics_karaoke_style.label: Highlight colors
lyrics_karaoke_style.description: Theme follows the live Noctalia palette. Custom uses the color pickers below.

lyrics_karaoke_sung.label: Sung color
lyrics_karaoke_sung.description: Already-sung words when Highlight colors is Custom.

lyrics_karaoke_active.label: Active color
lyrics_karaoke_active.description: Word currently being sung when Custom.

lyrics_karaoke_upcoming.label: Upcoming color
lyrics_karaoke_upcoming.description: Not-yet-sung words in the current line when Custom.

lyrics_osd_show_idle.label: Idle placeholder
lyrics_osd_show_idle.description: When the HUD is open with no lyrics yet, show a muted idle message instead of a blank overlay.

lyrics_show_untimed.label: Show untimed lyrics
lyrics_show_untimed.description: Off by default. Show plain lyrics that have no timestamps. Synced karaoke always shows.

lyrics_plain_scroll.label: Scroll untimed lyrics
lyrics_plain_scroll.description: Advance plain lyrics over the song length instead of freezing on the first line. Drift vs vocals is expected.

lyrics_plain_scroll_speed.label: Scroll speed
lyrics_plain_scroll_speed.description: Pace relative to song length (25–300%). 100 is default.

lyrics_plain_scroll_silence.label: Pause when quiet
lyrics_plain_scroll_silence.description: Hold scroll during quiet system audio (intros/gaps). Soft beds may pause too. Needs parec.

lyrics_plain_scroll_silence_level.label: Quiet threshold
lyrics_plain_scroll_silence_level.description: How loud audio must be before scroll advances (1–40).

show_cover.label: Show artwork
show_cover.description: Show Cider cover art on the bar chip when a local file is available.

cover_size.label: Artwork size
cover_size.description: Cover edge length on the bar chip (12–32 px).

glyph.label: Fallback glyph
glyph.description: Icon shown on the bar chip when artwork is hidden or missing.
